findings.question: Benefits & pensions (Entitlements, contributions and payment history for social security and state pensions): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: The SDM programme is supported through a series of information and communications technology (ICT) projects to add new and improve existing functionality on its main strategic system (Business Object Model implementation – BOMi).
findings.value: Business Object Model implementation (BOMi), the Department of Social Protection's main strategic system
findings.title: Service Delivery Modernisation and BOMi Development Programmes
findings.note: The PDF behind the gov.ie publication page the earlier search cited. That page could not be fetched; this assets.gov.ie copy can be.

findings.question: Education (Student records, diplomas and qualifications): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: In respect of students at primary and post-primary, the schools return the data on the students enrolled in their schools to the Department via the Primary and Post-Primary Online. Databases (POD & P-POD)
findings.value: POD & P-POD (Primary and Post-Primary Online Databases)
findings.title: 2023 Privacy Notice Department of Education (Updated January 2024)
findings.note: This is the Department's own privacy notice, stored in gov.ie's 'govieassets' S3 bucket. The host s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com may need its own entry in authorities.csv. The stray period after 'Online' is in the source.

review.established: Primary Online Database (POD) and Post-Primary Online Database (P-POD)
review.reason: The quote appears verbatim and names POD and P-POD as the databases through which schools return student enrolment data to the Department.

findings.question: Government payroll and personnel (Civil service and armed forces payroll and personnel records): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: In 2023, Enterprise ICT successfully delivered the upgrade to our core Human Resources Management System (HRMS) platform, PeopleSoft, to 44 of our clients.
findings.value: core Human Resources Management System (HRMS) platform, PeopleSoft (National Shared Services Office)
findings.title: National Shared Services Office Annual Report 2023
findings.note: NSSO's 2023 annual report names its core HR system. The same report says its ERP systems run in a 'hybrid cloud environment' but does not name a provider. Armed forces payroll is not covered here.

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim in the NSSO 2023 annual report and names the core HRMS platform, PeopleSoft, which was upgraded for 44 client bodies.

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim on the Courts Service news page and names the Unified Case Management System as the single digital platform for court operations.
